menu.caption: Genre: upbeat indie adventure rock, premium motorbike game soundtrack. BPM: 108. Key: D major. Instrumental only, absolutely no singing, spoken words, humming, choir or vocal samples. Arrangement: a memorable four-note rising motif on clean electric guitar and marimba; tight live drums, handclaps, warm bass; sunny confident outdoor expedition, a proper title melody with breathing room. A steady groove starts by the second bar and lasts to the end. A melodic hook develops over distinct phrases; avoid a monotonous two-bar loop. No fade-out, no long intro, no dramatic silence. Production: clear warm organic stereo mix, controlled sub-bass, leave room for a close engine and tyre sound in the center.
